metadata.primary_method: 3 fresh processes per mode/model; serial off/on, on/off, off/on; production CPU loader and solid upload; D3D11; >=2 s warm-up; 60 GPU frame samples
metadata.counter_method: One additional pair each for Powerplant and San Miguel; pipeline query in a separate frame after all timing samples. These four runs are not mixed into primary medians.
metadata.validation: All corner-attribute, source and pixel hashes match for each model across all runs; all five saved on/off PPM image pairs also match byte-for-byte.
